report:
Reviewed the complete claim, five ordinary implementation associations (annotations.rs, observe.rs, source.rs, symbols.rs, types.rs), and all eleven ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries exist. annotations parses sym to Sage symbol selection. source::walk supplies explicit CST expressions only; observe maps their spans/kinds to completed function.body results, filters paths by their source start line, rejects invalid correspondence, and requires at least one selected path. Typed generated expressions cannot independently introduce symbol selections because checked rows are derived from the source traversal. symbols::resolution uses completed PathResolution rather than source text; definition renders kind and qualified module/name for local items, metadata def_path for external items, explicit errors for unsupported local associated functions/constants, and <unresolved> only for semantic resolution errors (including checked error nodes). Local names count preceding same-named spans plus one, excluding unrelated declarations; tied/missing binding correspondence errors explicitly. types::qualified_local_name supplies module qualification. All frozen identities are owned strings produced during walk_expr/check_crate before collect drains inspection events; subsequent output formatting uses these strings without semantic reads.

The exact expectations in aliases_and_qualified_paths_identify_the_definition distinguish same-named functions in different modules and prove alias spelling is not identity. shadowed_locals_have_distinct_stable_identities observes original and shadowed value bindings as #1/#2 despite intervening unrelated bindings. external_definitions_use_metadata_paths asserts the external Ordering variant path. These complete output equalities exclude IDs/coordinates in identities. symbols_and_types_share_expression_headers matches the claim's path/call example, including symbol-before-type, and duplicate markers do not duplicate rows. symbol_selections_require_paths_and_expectations rejects both absent expectations and a literal-only line. unresolved_paths_still_require_error_markers rejects unaccounted diagnostics, then asserts <unresolved> separately from diagnostic/query outputs. unsupported_associated_identity_is_not_unresolved directly resolves a real local trait-associated function and asserts its explicit unsupported error. missing_local_correspondence_is_not_an_unresolved_name supplies an invalid local reference and asserts missing local binding, preserving the distinction from actual unresolved names.

New symbol_selection_excludes_field_names_types_and_let_patterns checks the complete inline observation includes only the receiver path and excludes its field, type annotation, and declaration pattern; an unselected later field use does not appear. New only_expression_paths_are_symbol_candidates tests the actual CST selector on field/method expressions and a pattern path, asserting exactly four receiver/scrutinee/body value paths and no method, field, type, or pattern names. This is intentionally selector-level evidence: the CST contains no elaborated implicit calls, and observe only emits rows originating there. It does not claim unsupported method or match checking is implemented. Earlier exploratory end-to-end selector fixtures encountered existing incomplete method-candidate and match-binding support; those fixtures were replaced with the direct selector test, without adding diagnostic markers or altering expected language behavior. cold_capture_includes_discovery_and_observation_reads_without_changing_bodies asserts an external symbol observation, executed tcx::def_path in the captured cold trace, unchanged trace with/without selection, and the same two checked bodies; combined with the frozen-string source boundary this accounts for freezing names before ending capture.

Captured supporting CompileTest macro/run/prepare code and in-memory setup/local-function helpers, plus PathResolution/LocalId/LocalVar declarations. Assertions remain visible in annotated test bodies. Executed cargo fmt, cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test observations (6 passed), cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib only_expression_paths_are_symbol_candidates (1 passed), cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib compile:: (35 passed), and cargo build (passed, existing warnings). This review assesses source correctness and test adequacy; it does not claim exhaustive testing of every local/external symbol kind. All claim aspects are covered by the combined implementation and focused evidence; no production changes or requested edits remain.
